criteria.description: One entry per testable rule found in the scope of work. Omit rules that cannot be tested from a conversation transcript and a CMMS record.

criterionId.description: Short stable id in the form GEN-<AREA>-<NN>, uppercase, e.g. GEN-LOG-01. Derive AREA from the subject of the rule.

clauseRef.description: The clause number as written in the scope of work, e.g. S-2.1. Use the document's own numbering; never invent one.

title.description: Short name for the check, under 80 characters.

description.description: What this criterion requires, in one or two sentences.

passDefinition.description: Exactly what must be observable in the transcript or the CMMS record for this to PASS. Written so two people reading it would reach the same verdict.

failDefinition.description: Exactly what makes this FAIL. Must be the complement of passDefinition, not a restatement of it.

layer.description: deterministic = answerable by comparing stored fields with no judgement. semantic = requires reading the conversation. Choose semantic unless the check is a pure field comparison.

severity.description: How serious a breach is for the caller. critical = the caller is left believing something happened that did not.

modality.description: voice = only meaningful on a spoken call (interruption, dead air, reading a number aloud). text = only meaningful in writing. any = both.

sourceExcerpt.description: The sentence or clause from the scope of work this criterion came from, quoted verbatim. Never paraphrase here.
